Emma: Big personal update 389497389 — our adoption was finalized today. We are officially a family of three!
Emma: Feeling a mix of relief, exhaustion, and so much happiness. Wanted to share because youve all been so kind these past months.
Rico: OMG EMMA 60d huge congratulations!!!
Sana: ahhh thats the best news 970 so happy for you both 495
Kendra: tears 62d congrats congrats congrats. Any party plans or low-key celebration?
Emma: Thank you!! Wed love something low-key next Friday after work. No gifts necessary but if folks wanted to chip in for a keepsake book that would be lovely.
Jon (People Ops): Congrats from People Ops too 389 I can help coordinate a card and a small group gift. Budget ok?
Emma: Appreciate that Jon. Maybe $20-30 per person suggested, but genuinely no pressure.
Leo: happy to contribute and help set up next Friday. I can bring drinks and a mini projector for a slideshow of baby photos.
Rico: Ill do snacks. Also can make a tiny custom illustration for the book if Emma is down?
Emma: that would be amazing, Rico 60a
Kendra: Quick poll: react with :ballot_box_with_check: if youre in-person next Fri, :phone: if remote and want to send a video message, :money_with_wings: if youll only contribute.
Sana: :ballot_box_with_check:
Leo: :ballot_box_with_check: projector guy
Rico: :ballot_box_with_check:
Jon (People Ops): :ballot_box_with_check: (will bring card and handle purchase)
Kendra: :money_with_wings:
ConfettiBot: Suggested contribution: $25pp based on 12 contributors -> Total $300. Create collection link?
Jon (People Ops): Ill set up a tracker and post a link by tomorrow. Deadline for contributions: 3 days before the event.
Emma: If anyone remote wants to send a short 10-15s clip, please DM me and Ill compile into the slideshow.
Sana: already have a cute 3-second clip from today! Sending now 60d
Rico: proposed card message: "Welcome to the family! So much love to you three 495  — Your Redwood friends" OK?
Emma: perfect 60a thank you all, Im honestly floored.
Jon (People Ops): Contribution tracker (edit):
- Contributors: Rico, Sana, Leo, Kendra, Jon, Maya, Amir
- Suggested per person: $25
- Total goal: $175 (initial pool), will adjust if more folks join
- Payment methods: Venmo/PayPal/Company pooled card
- Deadline: May 20
Kendra: Stealth note: were not planning anything huge; please keep social posts quiet until Emma posts publicly.
Emma: thanks team. Means a lot. Ill try to be around for the short celebration but might duck early with the little one.
Leo: bring pics please 4f7
Rico: cant wait to meet the tiny human 436
ConfettiBot: Collection link created: https://payments.example.com/collect/emma-adoption-1770321456
